rule.message: All prerequisite courses must be taken A-F. Biology and chemistry must be taken within five years of entry into the program and one or the other must be completed prior to application, so grades are on the transcript submitted at the time of application. In addition, applicants are strongly encouraged to have completed composition and psychology and/or sociology prior to application so grades are on the transcript submitted at the time of application. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

The BS in dental hygiene requires that students take six consecutive terms of courses, including summer terms.
Students must complete a minimum of 28 upper division major credits at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities.
A sample plan for this program is available at https://sampleplan.umn.edu/node/776 Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
Complete any sub-plan requirements that apply to you: Dental Hygiene B.S., Integrated Bachelor of Science Dental Hygiene/Master of Dental Therapy. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
